events.text: A coastal lighthouse is automated after decades of manned operation.

pages.title: Lighthouse
pages.description: Structure designed to emit light to aid navigation
pages.extract: A lighthouse is a tower, building, or other type of physical structure designed to emit light to serve as a beacon for navigational aid.

events.text: A mountain railway reopens after a long winter closure.

pages.title: Mountain railway
pages.description: Railway that operates in mountainous terrain
pages.extract: A mountain railway is a railway that operates in a mountainous region.

events.text: A famous orchestra performs an open-air concert beside a river.

pages.title: Orchestra
pages.extract: An orchestra is a large instrumental ensemble typical of classical music.
